title: The Last Group Chat
premise: Ivo Whitlock has spent four years as the invisible statistician of his high school's championship-bound soccer team, counting down to graduation while quietly tracking the rigged point system that keeps certain players on the field. When he finds his late grandmother's recipe box full of coded instructions — not recipes, but a map to a secret society of 'keepers' who have protected the school's true history for generations — he learns the rigging he discovered is only the surface of a decades-old cover-up involving his grandmother herself. As the final audition for the keepers approaches, Ivo must choose between exposing the truth and destroying his best friend's scholarship, and between staying invisible and claiming a legacy he never wanted. He wins the meaningless championship by throwing the rigged game in plain sight, passes the final audition by proving that truth matters more than loyalty to institutions, and ends the story rebuilding the keeper network on honest terms — with his name finally spoken aloud.
about_author: Xanthe Marchetti is a former high school math teacher who spent a decade collecting the secret languages of teenagers — group chats, coded notes, and the arithmetic of belonging. She writes near Chicago, where she keeps her own grandmother's recipe box, contents unverified.

chapters.title: The Arithmetic of Invisibility
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Establishes his role as the team's overlooked statistician and his countdown calendar to graduation. He notices an anomaly in the eligibility points — three players whose numbers can't be real. Emotional beat: the comfort and ache of being unseen.

chapters.title: Recipe for Disaster
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Clearing out his grandmother's kitchen, he finds her recipe box; among the cards are instructions for 'preserving the broth,' 'the quiet oven,' and coordinates that aren't for any pantry. Emotional beat: grief interrupted by a puzzle he can't put down.

chapters.title: Group Chat Ghosts
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV, intercut with the team's group chat transcripts. He tests the coded cards against school archives and realizes his grandmother graduated from the same school — fifty years before him. Emotional beat: the vertigo of discovering a hidden family.

chapters.title: The Point System
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. He confronts the rigged eligibility math directly and realizes Coach Renner's star players, including his best friend Dez's scholarship ticket, are built on fabricated points. Emotional beat: loyalty and truth pulling in opposite directions for the first time.

chapters.title: The Quiet Oven
chapters.summary: Dez's POV. Dez notices Ivo digging through old yearbooks and covers for him in front of the team, while privately wondering what his friend is hiding. Emotional beat: friendship as a reflex — protect first, ask later.

chapters.title: Card Seven: The Audition
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. A recipe card instructs him to leave a marked notebook in the library's oldest carrel; the next morning it's gone, replaced by a single card: 'The final audition is in May. Prove you can keep and tell.' Emotional beat: terror and thrill of being seen at last.

chapters.title: What Grandma Kept
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. He tracks down his grandmother's old friend, Ruth Okafor, who reveals the Keepers — students who documented what the school buried: expelled students, falsified records, and the point-rigging scheme's origin. Emotional beat: inheritance as burden.

chapters.title: Homecoming Numbers
chapters.summary: Marisol's POV, the team captain and a keeper descendant. Marisol recognizes the notebook's mark and must decide whether to recruit Ivo or protect the network from him. Emotional beat: duty versus instinct.

chapters.title: The Championship That Doesn't Matter
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The team surges toward the state championship on Dez's shoulders — and on the rigged points. Ivo runs the numbers and realizes the only way to expose the fraud is to let it fail spectacularly. Emotional beat: the cold clarity of a plan.

chapters.title: Ruth's Warning
chapters.summary: Ruth's POV. Ruth tells Ivo about the last keeper who 'told' without 'keeping' — a student destroyed by the school in 1974. She warns him the audition isn't a test of cleverness but of character. Emotional beat: fear sharpened into resolve.

chapters.title: Dez's Secret
chapters.summary: Dez's POV. Dez admits he's known his points were padded and has stayed silent to keep his scholarship and his mother's hope alive. He begs Ivo to let it be. Emotional beat: the cost of complicity, confessed.

chapters.title: The Broth Must Be Kept
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Following the cards to a storage room beneath the gym, Ivo finds the keepers' archive — fifty years of the school's true record, including his grandmother's final unfinished entry about the point system's modern revival. Emotional beat: awe curdling into anger.

chapters.title: Marisol's Terms
chapters.summary: Marisol's POV. Marisol offers Ivo keeper membership if he agrees to seal the archive and protect the network — the same silence that let the rigging continue. Emotional beat: the trap of tradition.

chapters.title: Group Chat, Deleted
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV, heavy with chat transcripts. Someone leaks a fragment of Ivo's findings into the team group chat, and the chat implodes — players turning on each other, Dez going silent. Emotional beat: truth as a grenade thrown by an unknown hand.

chapters.title: The Leak
chapters.summary: Marisol's POV. Marisol discovers the leaker is Coach Renner's aide, trying to discredit the keepers before the audition. She and Ivo form a fragile alliance. Emotional beat: enemies discovering they want the same thing for different reasons.

chapters.title: What Loyalty Costs
chapters.summary: Dez's POV. Dez must choose between testifying about his padded points and losing everything, as his mother celebrates his recruitment. Emotional beat: love as the heaviest weight on a conscience.

chapters.title: The Final Audition
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Before the school board and the hidden keepers, Ivo presents the archive and the rigged math — and refuses the traditional oath of silence, proposing instead a keeper network that publishes rather than conceals. Emotional beat: the audition's real question answered — he kept the truth and told it.

chapters.title: Championship Night
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. With the eligibility fraud under formal review, the team plays the final on merit — and loses by one goal, honestly. Ivo watches from the bench, statistics in his lap, and has never felt more part of something. Emotional beat: defeat that feels like victory.

chapters.title: Aftermath, Annotated
chapters.summary: Marisol's POV. The board suspends Renner; Dez's scholarship is re-earned through an honest showcase; Marisol becomes the new keeper-archivist under Ivo's open-record model. Emotional beat: institutions bending, slowly, toward light.

chapters.title: The Empty Carrel
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo leaves his own first entry in the library carrel — a card addressed to whoever comes next, explaining that the broth is the truth itself. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into legacy.

chapters.title: Graduation, Counted
chapters.summary: Dez's POV. Graduation day: Dez crosses the stage with his scholarship intact and his conscience lighter, and finds Ivo's countdown calendar — every day crossed out except the last, which reads 'day one.' Emotional beat: endings reframed as beginnings.

chapters.title: The Last Group Chat
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV, framed as the team's final group chat messages dissolving into a new chat named 'Keepers.' Ivo sends one message — the coordinates of the archive and an open invitation — and puts his phone away, visible at last. Emotional beat: belonging chosen, not assigned.
